intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个清晰信号：围绕 Agent 的配套层正在快速成形，从给 Agent 用的 UI 行为库、后台自动接活的调度器，到防止代码被 AI 逆向的防护工具，再到教人拆解视频、上手大模型的教程。真正稀缺的不再是模型本身，而是让 Agent 可靠落地、可控可审计、并且能被人验收的那一层。
intro.en: Today's projects point to a maturing layer around agents rather than new models: behavior libraries built for agents to drive UIs, background schedulers that let CLI agents pick up work unattended, defenses against AI-driven reverse engineering, and tutorials teaching people to use these tools.

zh.summary: 一个极轻量的本地自动化中台，让 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进，遇到需要决策的事才通过飞书、钉钉、Slack 等推卡片找人拍板。零外部依赖，一台电脑一条命令即可运行。
zh.insight: 适合做「无人值守 Agent 值班」的轻量产品：面向个人开发者和小团队，卖点是任务队列加人工审批卡片的闭环，和云端 Agent 平台比，优势在本地部署、数据不出机器。

en.summary: A lightweight local automation hub that lets CLI agents like Claude Code and Codex pick up and follow through on tasks in the background, pinging a human via Feishu,
en.insight: Aimed at unattended agent operations for solo developers and small teams: the value is the loop between task queue and human approval cards.

items.description: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。

zh.summary: 面向团队及其 Agent 的 AI 原生引擎，支持多种 harness 和多 Agent 协作，可自托管。它的主张是对话以答案结束，而一个请求要等到提问的人签字确认才算完成，强调人工验收环节。
zh.insight: 切的是团队里 Agent 产出无人把关的痛点：把审批和签核做成工作流的一等公民，适合做内部工具平台或交付型团队的 Agent 流水线，与纯对话式工具形成差异。

en.summary: An AI-native engine for teams and their agents, supporting multiple harnesses and multi-agent work, self-hosted.
en.insight: It targets the pain of unvetted agent output inside teams by making approval and sign-off part of the workflow.

items.description: The AI-native engine for teams and their agents. Multi-harness, multi-agent, self-hosted.

zh.summary: 上海交大课程讲义扩展而来的大模型编程实践教程，覆盖微调部署、数学推理、GUI Agent、对齐等主题，完全免费，还上线了国产化开发全流程公益教程。对想系统上手大模型的学生和转行者很实用。
zh.insight: 教程本身不是生意，但围绕它的陪练和项目制训练营是：面向高校课程设计和转岗人群，用它的实验手册做骨架，补上评测、答疑和作品集输出。

en.summary: A hands-on LLM programming course grown from a Shanghai Jiao Tong University class, covering fine-tuning and deployment, math reasoning, GUI agents and alignment, entirely free,
en.insight: The tutorial is not the business, but coaching around it is: target course projects and career changers, use its lab manuals as the skeleton,

items.description: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程

zh.summary: 通过逐层流式加载权重，让 70B 模型在单张 4GB 显卡上推理，无需量化、蒸馏或剪枝，并宣称能跑更大规模的模型，近期还加入了小显存训练支持。解决的是显存不足这个最硬的部署门槛。
zh.insight: 更适合作为基础设施能力而不是独立产品：可以嵌进私有化部署交付、边缘设备推理、教学实验环境。真正的机会在把这种省显存推理包装成开箱即用的本地模型服务。

en.summary: Streams weights layer by layer so a 70B model runs inference on a single 4GB GPU without quantization, distillation or pruning;
en.insight: Better treated as infrastructure than a standalone product: embed it in on-prem delivery, edge inference and teaching labs.

items.description: AirLLM 2.8T LLM inference with single 4GB GPU
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: Windows 上的安卓应用运行器，双击 APK 即安装，每个应用生成独立桌面图标和窗口，自带 QEMU 运行时，还做了 Windows 与安卓目录的双向文件同步。作者坦言是早期版本、业余时间维护。
zh.insight: 需求真实但体验粗糙，正是产品化的空隙：面向需要在 PC 上跑安卓办公或游戏小号的用户，做稳定性和兼容性打磨，比从零造模拟器更现实。

en.summary: An Android app runner for Windows: double-click an APK to install, each app gets its own desktop icon and window,
en.insight: Real demand, rough execution, which is exactly the product gap: serve users who need Android apps on PC for work or game alts,

items.description: Windows 上的安卓应用运行器：双击 APK 即装，应用以独立窗口与桌面图标运行，自持 QEMU 运行时

zh.summary: Vercel 实验室推出的 UI SDK，把键盘导航、焦点、选中、弹层、拖拽和 ARIA 等交互行为抽成 headless 核心，再提供 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components 适配。它面向的是让 Agent 生成界面的场景，组件由行为原语组合而成。
zh.insight: 切入点不是又一个组件库，而是给 Agent 用的设计系统底座：把无障碍和交互逻辑固化成可被模型调用的原语，做企业内部的 Agent 生成前端规范层，比让模型自由写组件更可控。

en.summary: Vercel Labs' UI SDK extracts keyboard navigation, focus, selection, popups, drag and drop and ARIA into a headless core, with adapters for React, Vue, Svelte,
en.insight: The opening is not another component library but a design-system substrate for agents: freeze accessibility and interaction logic into primitives models can…

items.description: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.

zh.summary: jQuery 4.0.0 正式发布，3.x 转入仅关键修复，2.x 和 1.x 停止支持。这个统治了上一代 Web 的库仍在大量存量站点中运行，新版发布对维护老项目的团队是一次明确的升级窗口。
zh.insight: 机会不在重造 jQuery，而在迁移服务：面向仍跑 1.x/2.x 的企业站点做兼容性评估和升级，或做检测旧版本与已知问题的扫描工具，卖给外包和运维团队。

en.summary: jQuery 4.0.0 is out, with 3.x moving to critical fixes only and 1.x/2.x unsupported. The library that ruled the previous web era still runs on a huge installed base,
en.insight: The opening is migration services, not a new jQuery: assess and upgrade enterprise sites still on 1.x/2.x,

zh.summary: 开源的蓝队 MCP 服务与 CLI，专门对抗 AI 逆向工程 Agent，覆盖 JS/TS、Electron ASAR、WASM、Python、原生二进制、SQLite、模型权重和 Android DEX。思路是通过投毒、耗尽、幻觉让自动逆向变得不划算。
zh.insight: 软件发布方是明确客户：独立开发者和小型软件公司担心自己的客户端被 AI 工具一键拆解。可以从混淆和反调试升级为「对抗 Agent 的发布流水线插件」，按构建次数收费。

en.summary: An open-source blue-team MCP server and CLI built to counter AI reverse-engineering agents, covering JS/TS, Electron ASAR, WASM, Python, native binaries, SQLite,
en.insight: Software shippers are the clear customer: indie developers and small vendors worried their clients get dismantled by AI tooling.

items.description: 🛡️ BLA (bla-agents / Blind LLM Agents) — Open-source Blue Defense MCP server & CLI protecting JS/TS, Electron ASAR, WASM, Python, Native Binaries, SQLite, GGUF/Safetensors & Android DEX against AI reverse-engineering agents (REA).

zh.summary: 逆向任意视频，逐镜头判断是实拍、AI 生成还是代码制作，并给出复刻方法，结果以开放的 VIDEO.md 格式输出，供 Agent 逐层读取。对做短视频投放和创意拆解的人有直接价值。
zh.insight: 可以做成广告和内容团队的竞品拆解工具：输入竞品短视频，输出镜头结构、生成方式和可复刻脚本。和人工拉片比，差异在于结构化格式能直接喂给制作 Agent。

en.summary: Reverse-engineers any video shot by shot, judging whether each was filmed, AI-generated or coded, then explains how to remake it.
en.insight: A competitive teardown tool for ad and content teams: feed in a rival's short video, get back shot structure, generation method and a reproducible script.

items.description: Reverse-engineer any video, shot by shot: filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Breakdowns in the open VIDEO.md format. 逆向一切视频，逐个镜头看是拍的、AI 生成的还是代码做的，再告诉你怎么复刻；拆解结果按 VIDEO.md 格式输出。

zh.summary: 用 Rust 写的插件化通用视频播放器，把浏览、搜索、播放和个人片库放在一个应用里，通过导入 JavaScript 插件接入不同内容来源。应用本身不内置内容源，也不分发第三方插件。
zh.insight: 它的价值不在播放器，而在插件协议：可以把这套「内容源插件加统一播放体验」的架构复用到企业内部视频库、课程平台或垂直内容聚合，绕开版权敏感地带。

en.summary: A plugin-based media player in Rust that bundles browsing, search, playback and a personal library in one app, connecting to content sources via imported JavaScript plugins.
en.insight: The value is the plugin protocol, not the player: reuse the source-plugin plus unified-playback architecture for internal video libraries,
